abstract_research_topics.justification: Biomimetic science involves understanding natural processes and developing theoretical frameworks for mimicking biological systems, fitting into abstract research.
Biostatistics involves statistical theories and methods in the context of biological systems, making it more aligned with abstract research.
Cognitive science deals with theoretical models of human cognition, which is abstract research.
Philosophy of science is a theoretical domain that examines the methods and implications of science, thus abstract.
This is a theoretical field that analyzes and critiques science and technology processes, thus abstract.

application_domains.justification: This domain refers to the use of deep learning in practical applications within biomedicine.
This domain refers to applying deep learning to practical issues in biomedicine and healthcare.
Biomedicine involves the application of biological and physiological principles to clinical practices using deep learning.
This domain focuses on the practical application of deep learning technologies in the development and enhancement of medical devices.
This involves applying deep learning to tailor medical treatments to individual patients.
Digital health employs deep learning in technology to improve healthcare delivery and efficiency.
Health informatics involves the use of information technology and analytics, including deep learning, to improve healthcare outcomes.
The domain focuses on using deep learning to enhance learning and teaching in medical schools and training.
This broad category refers to using deep learning in all aspects of healthcare.
Similar to healthcare, this involves applying deep learning across various medical fields.
Bioinformatics applies deep learning to manage and analyze biological data.
The application of deep learning in managing biological data and developing computational models for biology.
Cheminformatics uses deep learning to handle chemical data for drug discovery and other applications.
Similar to cheminformatics, this involves the practical application of managing and analyzing chemical information.
This involves the use of deep learning to model and simulate medical processes and diseases.
The use of algorithms, including deep learning, to solve biological problems.
Application of deep learning in solving problems at the intersection of biology and chemistry.
Using computational techniques, including deep learning, to solve biomedical problems.
Involves practical application of deep learning in solving biological problems.
Application of deep learning in the study and treatment of mental health issues.
